M45.11_evidence_certification.objective: Audit downstream code paths to verify they consume ONLY canonical mutmut evidence (via mutation_summary.json, measurement_truth.json, survivor_catalog, survivor_intel).
M45.11_evidence_certification.audit_method: Repository-wide grep for: (a) subprocess calls with 'mutmut' as executable, (b) status-string parsing (killed/survived/timeout/suspicious), (c) .meta/.spans file reads, (d) mutmut mutant-ID construction/parsing.

canonical_consumers.role: Authoritative runner — owns subprocess invocations of mutmut
Opt-in enrichment via mutmut tests-for-mutant; never feeds verdict

test_only_consumers: runtime/tests/test_mutation_infra.py — hermetic tmp-path cache provenance tests
backend/tests/conftest.py — in-process mutmut.__main__ import shim (no subprocess)

violations.issue: Calls subprocess.run([mutmut, 'results', '--all', 'true']) and subprocess.run([mutmut, 'show', ...]) directly; parses status strings. Duplicates canonical _MUTMUT_EXIT_CODE_TO_STATUS and parse_mutmut_results.
violations.impact: Does NOT feed the campaign verdict. The PURE classify() function IS consumed by survivor_intel (canonical reuse).
violations.remediation: REFACTOR: Have collect_results() and show_mutant() consume canonical mutation-summary.json + mutation-survivors.json. Deferred to follow-up — out of scope for M45.11 audit.

survivor_intelligence_consumption.subprocess: Optional enrich via 'mutmut tests-for-mutant' (opt-in, never feeds verdict)
survivor_intelligence_consumption.verdict: CANONICAL with documented opt-in forensic enrichment

M45.11_evidence_certification.summary: The Diagnostic Agent, Survivor Intelligence, and Strengthening Pipeline all consume canonical evidence. One violation: mutation_inventory.py has direct mutmut IO functions — kept for now because the PURE classify() function is heavily used.
M45.11_evidence_certification.next_step: M45.23 (architecture doc) declares the canonical evidence boundary; migration of mutation_inventory IO functions is deferred to a future milestone.

M45.12_legacy_boundary.objective: Enforce a clear execution-path boundary between canonical (verify.py mutation) and legacy direct-mutmut invocations.

implementation.summary_emission: execution_path is included in MutationResult.to_dict() and therefore in every mutation-summary.json and measurement-truth.json written by the runner.

shell_script_wrapper_audit.run_mutation_selective_sh: Delegates to 'verify.py mutation' (--full argparser-rejected flag removed M9-C45.9). Its invocation never produces LEGACY_DIRECT_BACKEND evidence.
shell_script_wrapper_audit.workflow_yml: Both mutation-smoke and mutation jobs invoke 'python runtime/verify.py mutation' — canonical. No LEGACY_DIRECT_BACKEND value is ever produced.

boundary_invariants.no_legacy_path_wired_into_workflows: PASS — audit of .github/workflows/*.yml finds zero direct mutmut invocations

M45.12_legacy_boundary.decision: M45.12 boundary enforced. Every evidence file produced by the canonical runner carries execution_path='VERIFICATION_CONTROL_PLANE'. Any future direct-mutmut consumer can be detected by absence of this field or by the LEGACY_DIRECT_BACKEND value, and explicitly excluded from certification verdicts.
